result.brief: 构建 Manim 程序生成-渲染-评审-修订轨迹数据集，并用角色条件 SFT 与强化学习训练 4B 模型自我纠错，提升教育动画渲染成功率与视觉质量。
result.reason: Focuses on code-generation agents and SFT/RL for Manim educational animation scripts; no contribution to video/world-model representation, generation architectures, or unified multimodal modeling.
